note: Reports logged before this form existed. Read-only: kept so testers can see how a report is written up and answered. Edit this file to add or update one.

reports.report: Address fields are typed by hand, so someone can enter a wrong value like a state called "Deltaaaa". They should be dropdowns, since the values are known.
reports.reply: Fixed 27 Oct. Nationality, state and local government are now dropdowns on the onboarding form and Edit Profile; the local government list follows the state you pick. Values already saved are kept.

reports.report: The magic-link sign-in email dropped into my spam folder.
reports.reply: The email's sender setup is the backend team's to fix (email authentication for the sending domain); we've asked them. Meanwhile the Check Your Email screen now says to look in spam or junk first.

reports.report: There's "State you live in" and "State of origin", so there should also be "Local Government you live in" and "Local Government of Origin".
reports.reply: Both are on the form now. Local government of origin appears on the live demo once the backend can store it (asked 27 Oct); until then the live form leaves it out rather than lose what you type.
The branded CGCC email is designed and handed to the backend; the server still sends a plain-text one. We've asked them to switch to the branded template.

reports.report: I was assigned the Multimedia department by default? (Dashboard also showed Member ID CGCC-00124 and CIH Garki Center 2.)
reports.reply: No department was assigned. Your sign-in link opened an old copy of the demo that showed sample details. Fixed 27 Oct: email links now open the current app, which shows only what is on your record. Sign in again with a new link to see it.
